traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements from docs/stories/020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are fully implemented and verified:
- File-Level Annotations: require-test-traceability, via ensureFileSupportsAnnotation, enforces that any file identified as a test file (based on configurable testFilePatterns) must contain at least one @supports annotation. Missing annotations trigger messageId "missingFileSupports" and, when allowed, a safe placeholder @supports block is auto-inserted at a semantically safe location. This is comprehensively tested. - Describe Block Story References: describe() calls in test files are required (by default) to have descriptions matching describePattern (default matching the "Story XXX.X-" form). Violations emit messageId "missingDescribeStory". This is enforced for all describe invocations (including nested) through handleCallExpression and tested with both passing and failing examples. - Test Name Requirement Prefixes: it/test calls in test files must have names starting with a canonical [REQ-...] prefix. The rule reports "missingReqPrefix" for missing or malformed prefixes, and optionally auto-fixes malformed-but-present IDs to canonical form without ever inventing new IDs. This behavior is tested for absence of prefix and several malformed variants. - Quality Standards: The rule follows ESLint RuleModule conventions, scopes its work to CallExpression nodes in files positively identified as tests, and uses simple regex and string operations. Auto-fixes are localized and guarded by conditions that avoid breaking semantics (preserving shebangs, quote styles, and not inferring unknown IDs). - Integration: The rule is exported from the plugin, registered in RULE_NAMES, and enabled at severity "error" in the TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES map, which feeds the recommended and strict flat configs. Jest/RuleTester-based tests exercise the rule as part of the standard test run. - Error Messages: All messages requested in the story (“Test file must have @supports…”, “describe() block should reference story…”, “Test name should start with requirement ID…”) are present in meta.messages and verified in tests. - Framework Support: Implementation explicitly supports describe, it, test, and context, and also handles member forms like describe.each/test.skip via getCalleeName. This covers Jest, Mocha, and common BDD-style variants and is tested (including a context() example). - Documentation: user-docs/api-reference.md contains a dedicated section for traceability/require-test-traceability and lists it in the default severity table, documenting behavior and configuration. This matches the story’s Documentation acceptance criterion and Definition of Done.
Given that the story text has not changed since the prior PASSED assessment, and all referenced implementation files, tests, integration points, and documentation are still present and passing under the current test run, the story is fully satisfied.
